comment: Voice->instrument map for probes/fixtures/arrangement-v1.abc and -v2.abc. Demonstrates the required shared-instrument case: PianoRH and PianoLH are TWO VOICES on ONE instrument. Programs are RAW MIDI bytes 0-127 (abc2midi convention, abcguide.txt); GM names are 1-indexed (raw 73 = GM #74 Flute).

edit_v1_to_v2.flute: bars 3-4 up one octave (d4g2b2 -> d'4g'2b'2 etc.)
edit_v1_to_v2.harmony: bars 6-7 chord G/D7 -> Em (bass and piano follow)
edit_v1_to_v2.purpose: the meaningful edit step of the workflow probe: same project, edited score, re-render

timing_features.purpose: adapter must carry conductor events, common timeline across voices, and correct endings
